summary: Grundy Airport tower in Buchanan County is listed as gone; it shares the name and near-exact point of Grundy Municipal Airport, closed in 2019. No source describes the tower.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. The airport it shares a name and location with closed on October 31, 2019.

access.note: Grundy Municipal Airport is permanently closed as of October 31, 2019. No source describes the tower site or its access.

events.note: Grundy Municipal Airport permanently closed as of October 31, 2019 (Wikipedia). This concerns the airfield; no source ties it to the tower's removal.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wikipedia says the airport was completed in 1969. The airfield history site dates it to 1961-63 and cites a 1963 USGS topographic map that depicts it. The story reports both and does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: The Association's list is the only source that names a tower here. No source read gives the tower's builder, height, purpose, staffing, or removal date. The link to the airfield rests on the shared name and on a listed point about 185 m from the airport's Wikipedia coordinates; the story says the two appear to refer to the same place and does not claim more. Dates conflict (1969 on Wikipedia; 1961-63 establishment and a 1963 map on the airfield site). The Wikipedia Grundy article says the airport is 'located in Vansant', which conflicts with the airport article's position three nautical miles southwest of Grundy; this was not used. The airfield site also describes a tower on another airfield's approach plate; that is a different field and was not used. The brief's access 'unknown' is replaced by 'closed' (airport closure per Wikipedia).
